item.title: Marco Rubio says US will push China to take a more 'active role' in Iran negotiations ahead of Trump-Xi summit
item.description: Secretary of State Rubio says the U.S. will attempt to convince Chinese leaders to play a more active role in pressuring Iran ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.

item.title: Missouri man’s explosives tutorial helped New Orleans terrorist plan NYE attack, feds say
item.description: Federal prosecutors accuse a Missouri man of posting bomb-making videos allegedly used by the ISIS-inspired terrorist in the Bourbon Street massacre.
